clue.text: Wholesale whiskey and fish paste

parts.note: W is whiskey in the NATO phonetic alphabet
the ide is a freshwater fish
a spread is a paste for bread, like fish paste

explanation.surface: A bulk-buy order of whisky and fish paste, as if for a shop.
explanation.definitionFit: Wholesale used of damage or change means extensive, affecting a broad area: a synonym.

clue.text: Promoters of health spa ultimately stop

parts.note: the WHO, the World Health Organization, promotes health worldwide

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word spa

explanation.surface: A health spa's promoters finally call a halt.
explanation.definitionFit: The interjection is a call to stop, originally to a horse; an exclamatory synonym.

clue.text: Modern artist — in Berlin, you will get Munch

parts.note: du is German for you, as spoken in Berlin
to champ is to munch or chew noisily

explanation.surface: In Berlin you'd see Munch's work, as if an art-gallery tip.
explanation.walkthrough: Munch looks like the Norwegian painter, but here it is the verb to chew.
explanation.definitionFit: Marcel Duchamp was a twentieth-century French artist central to Dada and conceptual art.

clue.text: Stops oatmeal getting sprinkled around large trifle

indicators.note: around means the rearranged letters go about the letter for large
sprinkled letters are scattered about, so the words stops oatmeal are rearranged

parts.note: L is the clothing-size abbreviation for large

explanation.surface: A cook stops oatmeal being scattered over a big trifle dessert.
explanation.walkthrough: Trifle looks like the dessert but is the noun meaning something unimportant.
explanation.definitionFit: Small potatoes is an idiom for something insignificant, the same as a mere trifle.

clue.text: Manipulate housing racket in old county area

indicators.note: housing means one word holds the other inside it

parts.note: to rig is to manipulate, as with a rigged vote
a din is a loud racket

explanation.surface: Rigging a housing scheme in a rural district, like a local scandal.
explanation.walkthrough: A Riding was one of the three old administrative divisions of Yorkshire, an English county.
explanation.definitionFit: Yorkshire was historically split into North, East and West divisions, each one a part of the county.

clue.text: Green light is item on phone with right shape

parts.note: an app is a program on a phone
an oval is a shape

explanation.surface: A traffic-light app on your phone that's the right shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting the green light means getting permission to go ahead, an idiom for consent.

clue.text: Information not following in religious book

indicators.note: not tells us the letter for following is absent from the word

parts.note: facts are information
F is the abbreviation for following, as in page references

explanation.surface: Information that doesn't come after something, found in a scripture.
explanation.definitionFit: The Acts of the Apostles is a book of the New Testament in the Bible.

clue.text: Person delivering The Telegraph's fancy rice cakes

indicators.note: cakes means coats or encrusts, so the rearranged letters wrap around the other piece
fancy suggests an elaborate reworking, so the word rice is rearranged

parts.note: the setter writes in the Telegraph, so its own paper is our

explanation.surface: A newspaper delivery person bringing fancy rice cakes.
explanation.walkthrough: The rearranged rice gives CIER, which coats OUR after its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A courier is a messenger who carries parcels or documents to recipients.

clue.text: Eccentric fixed outside step with rake

indicators.note: outside means the first word goes round the others

parts.note: set means fixed, as in set in stone
a pace is a step
a rake is a dissolute man, a cad

explanation.surface: An odd fellow, set in his ways, walking about with a garden rake.
explanation.walkthrough: Rake looks like a garden tool; here it is an old word for a womanising scoundrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A space cadet is slang for a dreamy, out-of-touch person, one who seems odd or spaced out.

clue.text: A lot of trees, if not leaves you can eat

parts.note: or means if not, as in hurry or you'll be late
chard is a leafy vegetable

explanation.surface: Fruit trees, or else leaves you can eat, as if foraging advice.
explanation.walkthrough: A lot is a plot of land here, not a large number.
explanation.definitionFit: An orchard is a piece of land planted with fruit trees.

clue.text: Proper, upper-class jacket of Lycra is ornamental

definitions.note: used as a noun: an ornamental plant

parts.note: prim means prim and proper, starchy

indicators.note: a jacket is the outside covering, so the outer letters of the word Lycra

explanation.surface: A prim, posh Lycra jacket that's merely decorative.
explanation.definitionFit: The primula, such as the primrose, is a flowering plant grown in gardens for decoration.

clue.text: I'm entertained in a form that's 'nouvelle vague'

indicators.note: in a form, here a new one, means the letters are arranged differently
nouvelle is French for new, showing the letters take a new order

explanation.surface: Someone amused by the French New Wave cinema movement.
explanation.walkthrough: The nouvelle vague was the French New Wave of 1960s film; read cryptically, a new form of the letters is vague.
explanation.definitionFit: Something indeterminate is not fixed or clearly defined, a synonym of vague.

clue.text: Motto of waiter, exhausted, needing G&T?

parts.note: all in means exhausted, worn out
G and T are the abbreviations for good and time, read as their full words

explanation.surface: A worn-out waiter's slogan, needing a gin and tonic.
explanation.walkthrough: G&T looks like gin and tonic, but its letters stand for good and time. The waiter is someone who waits patiently, not a server.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase counsels patience, so it suits one who waits as a guiding saying.

clue.text: PC needs these, which may be made from 3?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the tiny integrated circuits inside a computer
second meaning: very small chips, as you might fry from small potatoes, the answer to 3

explanation.walkthrough: The second reading is whimsical: tiny potatoes would give tiny fries.
explanation.definitionFit: Computers run on integrated circuits; jokingly, minuscule fried potato slices are tiny chips too.

clue.text: Comic performance better finishing early

indicators.note: finishing early means the word stops short, its last letter dropped

parts.note: to better is to improve

explanation.surface: A comedy act gets better by ending ahead of schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: Improv is short for improvisational comedy, an unscripted show of sketches made up on the spot.

clue.text: European region ousting leader accepts deed is cause of complaint

indicators.note: accepts means the shortened word takes the next piece inside
ousting leader means the first letter is removed

parts.note: Iberia is the peninsula of Spain and Portugal
an act is a deed

explanation.surface: A European region accepts a legal deed that triggers a formal complaint.
explanation.walkthrough: Without its leader the region gives BERIA, which accepts ACT. Complaint means illness here, not grievance.
explanation.definitionFit: Germs cause disease, and a complaint is an ailment, so microbes are its cause.

clue.text: Oscar stood up in predicament, showing great bottle

indicators.note: in means the reversed letters sit inside the other piece

parts.note: a jam is a predicament, a tight spot

indicators.note: up in a down answer means the letters read bottom to top

parts.note: O is Oscar in the NATO phonetic alphabet
bore means stood or tolerated

explanation.surface: An Oscar winner stood up in a tricky situation, showing great nerve.
explanation.walkthrough: Bottle is British slang for courage, the surface's sense, but here it is a literal container for wine.
explanation.definitionFit: A jeroboam is a large wine bottle, holding about four ordinary bottles of champagne.

clue.text: Aware when unusual knowledge to experience a revival

indicators.note: unusual shows the word aware is put in an unusual order

parts.note: ken is knowledge, as in beyond my ken

explanation.surface: Being aware when unusual knowledge comes is a kind of revival.
explanation.definitionFit: To come awake again or to be roused anew, a fresh start, which is a renewal.

clue.text: General Secretary follows American with control

indicators.note: follows means this piece comes after the others

parts.note: grip means control, as in get a grip
a PA, a personal assistant, is a secretary

explanation.surface: A general secretary trails an American who has things under control.
explanation.walkthrough: General looks like part of 'General Secretary' but is the definition: a Roman commander.
explanation.definitionFit: Marcus Agrippa was the Roman military commander who won the Battle of Actium for Augustus.

clue.text: Loud vocalist mostly chilled

parts.note: F is forte, the musical abbreviation for loud

indicators.note: mostly means the word is used with its last letter dropped

parts.note: a rapper is a vocalist

explanation.surface: A loud singer who is largely laid-back.
explanation.definitionFit: Frappé describes a drink served iced or with crushed ice, so it is cold.

clue.text: Greek god on long dash

indicators.note: on in a down answer means the first piece sits above the second

parts.note: Pan is the Greek god of the wild
to ache for something is to long for it

explanation.surface: A Greek god rushing along in a long dash.
explanation.definitionFit: Dash as in style or flair: panache is stylish verve.

clue.text: One in black shirt leaving street with a phone case

indicators.note: leaving means the street letters depart from the word

parts.note: Mussolini's fascists wore black shirts

explanation.surface: A Blackshirt walking off the street, carrying a phone case.
explanation.definitionFit: A fascia is a detachable cover for a mobile, also the facing panel on a shopfront.

clue.text: Proof what criminals do infiltrates my address

indicators.note: infiltrates means the robbing piece gets in between the others

parts.note: cor, like my, is an exclamation of surprise
an oration is a formal address
criminals rob

explanation.surface: Evidence that crooks have infiltrated my home address.
explanation.walkthrough: Cor is a British exclamation of surprise, like 'my!' or 'gosh!'.
explanation.definitionFit: Corroboration is evidence that confirms a claim, so it is supporting proof.

clue.text: Queen breaking finger, which is red

indicators.note: breaking means the queen piece splits the other word

parts.note: a finger of whisky is a tot, a small measure
R is from Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: A queen breaks a finger, which goes red.
explanation.definitionFit: A Trot is short for a Trotskyist, a left-wing radical, colloquially a red.

clue.text: Monkey regarding, say, Van Gogh's technique

parts.note: a monkey is a mischievous child, an imp
as to means regarding or concerning

explanation.surface: A monkey, regarding a Van Gogh, as if a gallery visit.
explanation.definitionFit: Impasto is paint laid on thickly so brushstrokes stand out, as in Van Gogh's work, which is an example.

clue.text: Court finally sent away unscrupulous opportunist

indicators.note: finally sent away means the last letter is dropped from the word

parts.note: Chancery is a division of the High Court in England

explanation.surface: A court finally expels a shady opportunist.
explanation.definitionFit: A chancer is British slang for someone who takes risks to exploit situations for gain.

clue.text: Saint John's perhaps a Czech

parts.note: john is slang for toilet, a lav; the 's stands for is, a link

explanation.surface: Saint John's might be a Czech, as in a church.
explanation.walkthrough: John is American slang for toilet and lav is the British word, so they mean the same thing.
explanation.definitionFit: The Czechs are one Slavic people, so a Czech is an example of the broader ethnic group.

clue.text: Carry out tours around area, running through

indicators.note: tours around means the word goes round the area letter

parts.note: to implement is to carry out

explanation.surface: Carry out tours around an area, running through it.
explanation.definitionFit: Impalement is piercing with a spike or sword, being run through.
